title: Provide reproducible source input for bootstrap query reconciliation
description: Follow-up from eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1.3. The bootstrap ledger now emits stable recordKey/clauseId/path/sourceSpan identities and explicitly marks source-negative rows as second-input-unavailable. Supply a machine-readable source-clause inventory, then join it with the bootstrap queries and authoritative ledger so negative/source-comparison claims are reproducible.
